title: Offer evaluation and onboarding trigger playbook
author: Nina R. Shah
content:
> **Archived 2027-03-15:** this page is superseded by "Evidence-driven offer evaluation and onboarding trigger playbook" and is kept for reference only.

Summary:
This playbook describes how Redwood Inference evaluates offers using shared evidence and how signed offers kick off the right onboarding pathway. It brings offer decisions, negotiation tracking and onboarding handoffs into one decision matrix, one negotiation log and a set of onboarding triggers based on role risk, compliance needs and ramp goals.

Who this is for:
- Hiring managers
- Recruiters and Talent Acquisition
- HR Business Partners (HRBPs)
- People Ops specialists building onboarding curricula
- Legal and Finance for offer approvals

Goals and principles:
- Transparent, auditable offer decisions via a standard scorecard.
- Faster offers without lowering decision quality (target: 72-hour typical offer SLA from verbal approval).
- Onboarding pathways triggered from objective signals (role, clearance, vendor status, critical deliverables).
- Negotiation outcomes and commitments recorded centrally for manager and HR follow-through.

Key owners and roles:
- Recruiter: candidate communications, initial offer package, scorecard entry.
- Hiring Manager: technical/cultural evaluation, ramp objectives, L4/L5+ approvals.
- HRBP: comp band and local labor law compliance; benefits language.
- Finance: sign-off on salary above band midpoint + 20% (approval threshold).
- Legal: contractor/consultant engagements and NDAs.

Offer evaluation process (step-by-step):
1) Complete the Offer Scorecard before any verbal offer
   - Owners: Recruiter + Hiring Manager
   - Fields: role level, proposed base, equity, bonus eligibility, reason for hire, and 0–5 scores for technical fit, problem-solving, role-specific skills, team fit and ramp risk.
   - Attachments: interview scorecards, reference notes, comp benchmarking snapshot.

2) Decision Matrix
   - candidate_score >= 4.0 AND proposed_comp <= band_midpoint + 10% -> auto-approve (Recruiter/HRBP finalize).
   - candidate_score 3.0–4.0 OR proposed_comp between band_midpoint + 10% and +25% -> HRBP + Hiring Manager sign-off.
   - candidate_score < 3.0 OR proposed_comp > band_midpoint + 25% OR atypical clauses -> Finance + Legal review plus exec sponsor.

3) Negotiation and Risk Log
   - Capture: candidate_request, impact_on_budget (Y/N), manager_commitments (Y/N), date, negotiator, final decision.
   - Every deviation from the standard package goes into the candidate dossier.

4) Offer SLA targets
   - Verbal offer: within 72 hours of decision to hire.
   - Written offer (HRBP/Legal signed): within 72 hours of verbal acceptance.
   - Exceptions (contractor conversion, export control, security clearance): up to 10 business days.

Offer Scorecard (required fields)
- candidate_name | role | level | technical_score (0-5) | problem_solving (0-5) | team_fit (0-5) | ramp_risk (low/med/high) | aggregate_score (0-5) | proposed_comp_pct_vs_band_mid | approvals_required

Approval threshold examples
- Aggregate >= 4.0 and comp <= +10% => Recruiter + HRBP.
- Aggregate 3.0–3.9 or comp +10%–+25% => Hiring Manager + HRBP.
- Aggregate < 3.0 or comp > +25% => Finance + Legal + Exec sponsor.

Onboarding trigger taxonomy
The People Ops intake system evaluates these when the candidate signs.
- Role risk (escalate immediately): PII/PHI access, admin network access, SOC2 high-impact role => Restricted onboarding (security clearance checklist, 1:1 with a Security engineer before day one).
- Compliance: EEA employment, contractor-to-employee conversion, background check flags => Extended HR/Legal onboarding.
- Ramp-critical: measurable Q1 deliverables or cross-team dependencies => Accelerated immersion (prestart reading, buddy, condensed 30-day objectives).
- Remote/new-country: outside primary region or relocating => remote-localization packet plus payroll/accounting enrollment.

Onboarding pathways
- Core Standard: 90-day plan with security training, benefits enrollment, manager 30/60/90 goals, weekly 1:1s.
- Restricted: extra security orientation, expedited IAM provisioning, elevated audit logging for the first 30 days.
- Accelerated Immersion: preboarding checklist, narrowly scoped project, daily standups for 2 weeks, weekly deliverable reviews.
- Compliance-Extended: staged paperwork and legal sign-offs; production access withheld until checks clear.

Manager checklist (30/60/90)
- Day 0–7: equipment and access, 30/60/90 alignment, buddy intro, small first-week deliverable.
- Day 8–30: weekly check-ins, security/compliance training confirmed, first deliverable reviewed, ramp plan adjusted.
- Day 31–90: bi-weekly checkpoints against the three KPIs set at offer; 90-day calibration with HRBP.

Metrics and reporting:
- Offer conversion (verbal -> signed): >= 80%.
- Median time-to-offer: <= 4 days.
- Approval exceptions: reviewed monthly; under 5% of hires.
- Pathway accuracy at 90 days: >= 90% correct routing.

Escalation and exceptions:
- Unusual packages go through the Hiring Exception queue with business justification, alternates considered and an ROI statement.
- Exceptions older than 14 days without approval auto-escalate to People Ops Director.

Templates:
1) Negotiation log CSV header: date, negotiator, field_changed, candidate_request, decision, cost_delta_to_budget, manager_comment
2) Offer email snippet: "We are excited to extend the role of <ROLE> at Redwood Inference. Your base salary will be <AMOUNT>, equity <DETAILS>, and benefits <LINK>. Please review the attached offer and return a signed copy by <DATE>."
3) 30/60/90 goals: three objectives per period with success criteria, owner and measurement.

Governance:
- Owner: People Ops (Nina R. Shah).
- Reviewed annually or after major comp band or legal changes.
- Policy changes: HRBP + Head of People; process changes: People Ops Director.

Appendix: approval email subject
- "Approval Request: Offer for <Candidate Name> — Role <Role> — Level <L#> — Compensation uplift <+X%>"

Kept for historical reference only; use the current evidence-driven playbook for live offers.
